messages:
maia: quick sync: I'm drafting an SDK surface that unifies pagination and streaming with optional resume checkpoints. want to capture tradeoffs for retries and transport.
sam: key concern: streaming + resume means server must emit stable checkpoints; otherwise resumes will re-run expensive work. need server-side job id + processed offset.
ben: surface idea: single API `client.iter()` returning {item, meta}. mode param: 'page' | 'stream' | 'checkpointed'. in checkpointed mode meta occasionally includes meta.resume_cursor and meta.job_id.
lia: also recommend opt-in resume to avoid surprising billing. default remains page-based. add config: checkpoint_interval (items) and adaptive:true/false.
maia: transport: runtime hides HTTP/grpc differences but define canonical header names: X-RW-CURSOR, X-RW-JOB, X-RW-IDEMPOTENCY. also duplicate cursor in response body in case headers dropped.
sam: retries: if no cursor seen, SDK does normal retries but won't resume. if cursor seen, SDK may attempt automatic resume up to N times using last cursor + idempotency header. document that duplicates possible.
ben: languages: TS -> AsyncIterable, Py -> async generator, Go -> receive-only chan. small helper to persist cursor (string) for apps.
lia: server: implement best-effort dedupe by (job, offset) and return processed_offset. include replayed flag when resume caused re-execution.
ci-bot: tests: hybrid-checkpoint-ci passed (build 5040) :white_check_mark:
maia: next: I'll write RFC with exact headers, response schema, error codes for resumeable vs fatal, and SDK examples. owners: maia (lead), ben (shape), lia (server). sam will run perf on checkpoint intervals.
sam: will run perf probes this week and report.
maia: thanks all, RFC incoming.
